description: Establish the green baseline before any change. Confirm the venv, run the full existing pytest suite with an extended timeout, and record the 275-test baseline so later features can prove nothing regressed.
steps: Activate/confirm the venv at /projects/sandbox/.venv (python3.9 + pytest + PyYAML; bandit/ruff/radon/pip-audit/flake8; cppcheck/clang-tidy; cmake/g++/ctest; Flask).
Run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest .apia/scripts/tests/ -q` with a timeout >= 600000 ms (the C++ e2e tests build GoogleTest via CMake in real time; the full suite is ~220s and growing).
Confirm all 275 tests pass. Capture the exact count for later comparison.
Run `.venv/bin/python -m py_compile .apia/scripts/*.py` to confirm the scripts compile cleanly.
acceptance_criteria: All 275 existing tests pass with the extended timeout.
py_compile reports no errors for the scripts under .apia/scripts/.
findings: Baseline green: 275 passed in 220.62s with the extended timeout. Scripts compile. Branch iterate-to-best matches apia-origin/main.
